map.由调制波与载波幅度求调幅指数 使用指南: Modulation index from modulating wave and carrier amplitude guide
map.输入调制波幅度 Am 与载波幅度 Ac，按 m = Am / Ac 计算调幅指数: Enter the modulating wave amplitude Am and carrier amplitude Ac to compute the modulation index by m = Am / Ac and judge over-modulation, for AM broadcast and envelope modulation design analysis.
map.输入调制波幅度 Am 与载波幅度 Ac，求调幅指数。: Enter the modulating wave amplitude Am and carrier amplitude Ac to get the modulation index.
map.调幅波调制指数 m = 调幅分量/载波幅度。: AM modulation index m = modulating component / carrier amplitude.
map.判断是否过调幅（m>1 失真）。: Judge whether it is overmodulated (m > 1 distorts).
map.：调制指数 m = 2 / 5 = 0.40，属于正常调幅（m<1 不失真）。: : modulation index m = 2 / 5 = 0.40, i.e. normal modulation (no distortion while m < 1).
map.：若 m=1.2（>1），则包络过零反转产生严重失真，应避免。: : if m = 1.2 (>1), the envelope crosses zero and reverses, producing severe distortion, which should be avoided.
map.由频偏与调制频率求调频指数: Modulation index from frequency deviation and modulating frequency
map.过调幅使包络不再与调制信号成正比，解调后出现截断失真。: Over-modulation makes the envelope no longer proportional to the modulating signal, causing clipping distortion after demodulation.
map.边带功率占比随 m² 增长，m 越大信息功率占比越高但越易过调。: Sideband power share grows with m^2; larger m raises the information power share but risks over-modulation.
